name: UIDT v3.6: Unified Information-Density Theory - Complete Manuscript
description: The UIDT v3.6 software suite provides the canonical implementation and verification environment for the Unified Information-Density Theory. It includes the Python solver for the parameter-free derivation of the Yang-Mills Mass Gap (1.710 GeV) and the Universal Gamma Invariant (16.339). This Complete Manuscript establishes the 'Three-Pillar Architecture' and formalizes the 'CSF-UIDT Synthesis' (Covariant Scalar-Field Unification). The suite simulates the 99-step Renormalization Group (RG) cascade for vacuum energy suppression, calibrates cosmological observables (H0, S8, w(z)) against 2025 DESI DR2 data, and models Supermassive Dark Seeds (SMDS).
citation: Rietz, P. (2025). Universal Gamma Scaling: Unified Information-Density Theory (UIDT v3.6) - Complete Manuscript with Three-Pillar Architecture. Zenodo. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17835200
